fact: TechReviewAfrica reports that Eswatini reviewed and validated its National Data Governance Policy (2027-2031) at a stakeholder validation; the article states no cabinet approval, launch or issue by the government.

Eswatini Positive News reports the proposed National Data Governance Policy (2027-2031), a draft of nine pillars, was being validated at a workshop in Ezulwini with the ICT Under Secretary speaking for the Minister; no adoption is stated. The date is the article's published date.

TechReviewAfrica reports the Ministry of ICT held the first two-day national workshop on a National Data Policy to gather stakeholder input for the final policy, so the policy was being developed. The date is the article's published date.
The EU Delegation states that on 29 April 2026 a two-day stakeholders' workshop opened in Mbabane to help create Eswatini's national data policy, supported by the EU, Member States and GIZ.

Eswatini Positive News reports ICT Minister Maziya told the Senate the National Data Governance Policy, being developed by the Ministry, is expected to be completed before the end of 2026. The date is the article's published date.

Smart Africa issued a request for proposals (RFP# 131/SA/RFP/07/2025, budget US$70,000, closing 25 August 2025) to procure the writing of an Eswatini national data policy; the source describes the policy as at procurement stage, not yet drafted, and nothing adopted.

fact: Minister Savannah Maziya opened the first national stakeholder workshop to begin drafting a National Data Policy, with a public comment period planned.
